answer: The GAO AI Accountability Framework recommends that entities document the sources and origins of data used to develop AI models. This includes providing documentation on how data have been collected, prepared, labeled, and maintained, as well as how data are monitored on a continual basis to ensure data quality and reliability. Additionally, entities should assess the reliability of the data used in model development, ensuring that the data are accurate, complete, and valid, and that they represent the populations served by the AI system.
